title: Gnarly zone connections
description: Building-level links between elevator nodes in different floor zones. Each floor zone has its own ARWorldMap; matching elevator nodes are the waypoints that connect floors. Connections are bidirectional. A ride's A* weight is a boarding cost plus a per-story cost.

zoneId.description: Zone whose building.json contains the node.

nodeId.description: Node id in that floor zone's building.json, such as elevator-east.
